template.label: Refactor
template.description: Behavior-preserving restructure backed by characterization and parity checks.
template.when_to_use: Use when changing structure, names, or organization without intended behavior change.

steps.label: Define invariants
steps.guidance: State what must remain unchanged and what structure is allowed to change.

steps.label: Characterize current behavior
steps.guidance: Run or add checks that would fail if behavior changed accidentally.

steps.label: Refactor incrementally
steps.guidance: Make small structural changes, keeping characterization checks passing.

steps.label: Prove parity
steps.guidance: Run relevant tests and inspect the diff for unintended behavior changes.

steps.label: Handoff
steps.guidance: Summarize the restructure, parity evidence, and any residual risk.
